name: Slicer
description: Represents a slicer in a workbook.
remarks: Each Slicer object represents a slicer in a workbook. Slicers are used to filter data in PivotTable reports or OLAP data sources. Use the Add method to add a Slicer object to the Slicers collection. To access the SlicerItem object that represents the currently selected button in a slicer, use the ActiveItem property of the Slicer object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the Worksheet object that represents the sheet that contains the slicer. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the specified slicer. Read/write.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets the caption of the specified slicer. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical position of the specified slicer, in points, relative to the upper-left corner of cell A1 on a worksheet. Read/write.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal position of the specified slicer, in points, relative to the upper-left corner of cell A1 on a worksheet. Read/write.

properties.name: DisableMoveResizeUI
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the specified slicer can be moved or resized by using the user interface. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the specified slicer, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the specified slicer, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: RowHeight
properties.description: Returns or sets the height, in points, of each row in the specified slicer. Read/write.

properties.name: ColumnWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width, in points, of each column in the slicer. Read/write.

properties.name: NumberOfColumns
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of columns in the specified slicer. Read/write.

properties.name: DisplayHeader
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the header that displays the slicer Caption property is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the specified slicer can be modified when the sheet that contains it is protected. Read/write.

properties.name: SlicerCache
properties.description: Returns the SlicerCache object associated with the slicer. Read-only.

properties.name: SlicerCacheLevel
properties.description: Returns the SlicerCacheLevel object associated with the slicer. Read-only.

properties.name: Shape
properties.description: Returns the Shape object associated with the specified slicer. Read-only.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the style currently applied to the specified slicer. Read/write.

properties.name: ActiveItem
properties.description: Returns a SlicerItem object that represents the slicer button that is currently in focus for the specified slicer. Read-only.

properties.name: TimelineViewState
properties.description: The timeline-specific state of the slicer. Read-only TimelineViewState.

properties.name: SlicerCacheType
properties.description: Returns the type of the slicer cache: slicer (xlSlicer) or timeline (xlTimeline) . Read-only XlSlicerCacheType.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the slicer and removes it from the associated Slicers collection.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Cuts the specified slicer and copies it to the clipboard.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified slicer to the clipboard.
